warrant_correction_qou_vuaj.mass_channel_scope: Explicitly mass-scoped via lem:feynman-eigenbasis-decomposition (2-eigenvalue mass operator => dim V_mass = 2 => Lambda^3_q V_mass = 0). Does NOT prove dim V_decay = 2 or force y_{(1^3)} = 0 in the decay channel; bean qou-n1dj is status todo.
warrant_correction_qou_vuaj.decay_channel_scope: Because chi^{(2,1)}(Delta_S) = 0 and chi^{(1^3)}(Delta_S) = -chi^{(3)}(Delta_S), the decay trace pairing depends on the weights only through g = y_{(3)} - y_{(1^3)}. Setting t = y_{(1^3)} = 0 (`cap_member_of_family`) is the two-row representative selected by the Convention-D ruling z = z_D, not forced by the decay observable.

slice_B1_fixed_y21_at_zD.conclusion: At fixed y_{(2,1)}(z_D), increasing t = y_{(1^3)} >= 0 strictly decreases g(t) = g(z_D) - 2t away from g_required; reaching g_required requires t = -0.19186079197006352147 < 0 (violating positivity).

slice_B2_full_simplex_abandoning_zD.conclusion: On the 1-parameter Ocneanu Markov curve, reaching g = g_required requires z_required = 0.998500302563 in (z_D, q), where y_{(1^3)}(z_required) = -0.0141306962 < 0 (violating weight positivity); across the entire non-negative nontrivial Ocneanu region z in (-1/q, z_D] where y_{(1^3)}(z) >= 0, g(z) <= g(z_D) = 0.5054042265. Reaching g = g_required with non-negative weights requires abandoning both z = z_D and the Ocneanu Markov trace relation for the general 2-simplex segment t in [0, 0.0554370948], which introduces unpinned free parameters.

data.verdict: SCOPE-(a) TERMINUS (conditional on the Convention-D z = z_D representative, plus explicit 1-parameter free-y_{(1^3)} sweep per qou-vuaj). Warrant correction: QOU/BraidsAndKnots/FibreDimensionForcesTL.lean is explicitly mass-scoped (lem:feynman-eigenbasis-decomposition) and bean qou-n1dj is todo; on the decay side, QOU.QBeta.DecayFibreBarParity.threeRow_undetermined_by_decay proves the decay trace pairing depends on the weights only through g = y_{(3)} - y_{(1^3)}, leaving t = y_{(1^3)} undetermined by the decay channel alone, with t = 0 (`cap_member_of_family`) the two-row representative selected by the Convention-D ruling z = z_D. At the z = z_D (t = 0) representative, g(z_D) = 0.5054042265 against a required 0.8891258104. Across the 1-parameter family at fixed y_{(2,1)}(z_D), g(t) = g(z_D) - 2t <= 0.5054042265 for all t = y_{(1^3)} >= 0, so non-negative 3-row weight moves g in the wrong direction (reaching g_required at fixed y_{(2,1)}(z_D) would require negative weight t = -0.1918607920). On the 1-parameter Ocneanu Markov curve y_lambda(z), reaching g_required requires z_required = 0.9985003026 in (z_D, q), where y_{(1^3)}(z_required) = -0.0141306962 < 0 (violating weight positivity); across the entire non-negative nontrivial Ocneanu region z in (-1/q, z_D] where y_{(1^3)}(z) >= 0, g(z) <= g(z_D) = 0.5054042265. Only by abandoning both z = z_D and the Ocneanu Markov relation for the general 2-simplex y_{(3)} = g_required + t, y_{(2,1)} = (1 - g_required - 2t)/2, y_{(1^3)} = t with t in [0, 0.0554370948] is g_required reachable with non-negative weights, at the cost of unpinned free parameters. The other two legs at z = z_D remain measured-negative: the character ratio an element would need, 1.5516573513, matches no declared form (nearest [3]_q/[2]_q at 2.45 %, next 3/2 at 3.33 % -- basket distance, not isolation), and the trace->MeV scale was enumerated on 2026-08-29 with nothing within 6.31 %. NOT a proved impossibility: this is an enumeration over declared classes, and a DERIVED (not searched) decay element with the right character ratio would still close it.
